title: RELX Essential 2 Device Kit
description:
Introducing RELX Essential 2 Device

1. Superior Power Output
With a higher 10W power output, the Essential 2 ensures a vaping session that surpasses its predecessor.

2. Longer-lasting battery with Quick Charging
Equipped with a 380mAh battery, the Essential 2 guarantees extended usage without frequent recharges. Plus, with its quick charging capability, you can charge up to 80% in just 30 minutes, ensuring you’re always ready to go with minimal downtime.

3. Enhanced Design with Clear Indicators
Stay informed with the clearer LED indicator:

In Use:

- White LED flashes slowly = normal use.

- Red LED flashes slowly = low power.

- Red LED flashes 10 times = out of power.

Charging:

- LED flashes slowly = charging.

- Constant white LED = fully charged.
